Question:
For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

SQL:
SELECT bt.name as title_name, 
       m.duration, 
       CAST(w1.name AS TEXT) as winner_name, 
       CAST(w2.name AS TEXT) as loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts bt ON m.title_id = bt.id
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id
WHERE bt.name LIKE '%NXT%'
AND m.title_change = 0
AND TRIM(m.duration) != ''
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, 1, INSTR(m.duration, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
         CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, INSTR(m.duration, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 5
